verdict.rationale: The REST reference documents GET /v1/models, which lists the models available to the API key. Its documented response schema includes IDs, creation times, aliases, context_length, per-token pricing and a capabilities object, so an agent can enumerate the live catalog programmatically. An OpenAPI spec is served at docs.x.ai/openapi.json, and the API is OpenAI-compatible, which aids agent tooling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint returns the live catalog as documented.
